records.issue_text: [BUG] OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_item_key calls math.floor on the datetime order key, raising TypeError and returning 500 on previous-page requests — the paginator cannot work for the endpoint it was written for
records.rationale: In `OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_item_key`, the code does `value = getattr(item, self.key)` and then applies `math.floor/ceil` and casts to `int`: `int(math.floor(value) if self._is_asc(for_prev) else math.ceil(value))`. In `organization_auditlogs.py`, the optimized paginator is used with `order_by="-datetime"`, so `self.key` will correspond to a datetime-like attribute on the model items. Applying `math.floor/ceil` to a `datetime` raises `TypeError`, causing a 500 when pagination builds cursors (including prev-page cursor generation).
